Gideon Sato, here's a draft for Mateo's procurement team, based on #inc-vtg-hartford:

*Hartford gate check-in incident, 3 Aug 2026 (ticket INC-4821)*
• *First report:* 10:42 AM. The gate kiosks at Vantorre's Hartford plant were offline, and both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. The guard logged trailer numbers by hand in the meantime.
• *Kiosk 1 back:* 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
• *Both lanes confirmed working:* 11:07 AM, posted in the channel at 11:08 AM.

This affected gate check-in only. Scheduling stayed available from the dispatch office. Carrowmere Cloud checked the Hartford gateway route. Access to the status page for Mateo's login is a separate issue that was still open at the last update.

Times are as shown in the incident channel. The channel doesn't state a time zone.
